rationale: C14 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both orders assign a presidential aide or chairman a set of specifically described functions, beginning with advising the President and continuing through the development or coordination of executive-branch policies, standards, plans, and management practices. Both then provide for performance through or with personnel and facilities associated with other governmental units. C09 and C11 contain related government-wide policy, evaluation, coordination, and management-improvement machinery, but their language and operative structure are less closely aligned with the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: perform the following-described functions ... Assist the President ... and advise and assist the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Telecommunications Advisor shall assist and advise the President with respect to the following-described telecommunications functions
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared formulation introducing an enumerated portfolio of functions centered on assisting and advising the President.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the establishment of policies and standards for the guidance of the executive departments and agencies
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Coordinating the development of telecommunications policies and standards applying to the executive branch of the Government
shared_material.explanation: Both assign responsibility for executive-branch-wide development or coordination of policies and standards.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a program designed to raise the level of effectiveness of personnel management ... and to bring about the proper coordination ... among the executive departments and agencies
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Assuring high standards of telecommunications management within the executive branch ... Coordinating the development by the several agencies ... of telecommunications plans and programs
shared_material.explanation: The same functional sequence—improving management standards and coordinating agency programs—is adapted from telecommunications to civilian personnel management.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall perform his functions under this order with the assistance of such personnel of the White House Office ... and ... personnel of the Civil Service Commission
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall, to the maximum extent feasible, perform his functions with the aid, or through the facilities, of appropriate departments and agencies of the Government
shared_material.explanation: Parallel supporting-administration clause specifies that the designated official performs the assigned functions using personnel or facilities supplied by other governmental units.
